snippet.title: Console compatible B3313 is here! - A2 Anniversary Edition trailer
snippet.description:
This is the release trailer of B3313 Unabandoned A2: Anniversary Edition. This is NOT A3 and only includes the compression, optimization and hotfixes with no other feature additions, while A3 remains in development.

Edit: From the hijacking of B3313 A3 from 2025 Oct on, it's taking a far different turn from what I'd been going for. You may enjoy it, maybe even more than what I was planning, just raising awareness to clear former expectations as I am no longer involved.

Get it on romhacking.com: https://romhacking.com/hack/b3313-unabandoned
Or the web patcher (more convenient for mobile users): https://chlorobyte.me/b3313/

References:
- Nintendo's beloved Super Mario 64, as well as development material thereof. B3313 is a non-profit fan modification that requires ownership of the original classic to play.
- Firstcom music tracks FC-A36-005, FC-A36-006, continuing the tradition of using beta-adjacent soundtracks for our trailers.
- B3313 0.9 on SummerCart64 footage: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_MhMMv1z9uc
